question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Frantic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Distraught)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Frantic"** means showing extreme emotion, often due to stress, worry, or fear; it refers to someone behaving in a wildly excited or hurried way. (उन्मत्त)

 
 
• **Example:** She made frantic calls to her friends when she realized she had lost her wallet.
 
 
 
• **"Distraught"** refers to someone who is deeply upset, worried, or agitated, often to the point of being unable to think clearly. (हताश)
 
 
• **Example:** He was distraught after hearing the news of his friend’s accident.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "Distraught" is the synonym of "Frantic".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Distraught)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Kinetic** (गतिशील): Relating to or resulting from motion.

 
 
• **Example:** The kinetic energy of the moving car was enormous.
 
 
 
• **Quaint** (पुरानी शैली का): Attractively unusual or old-fashioned.
 
 
• **Example:** We stayed in a quaint little cottage during our vacation.
 
 
 
• **Magnanimous** (उदार): Generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival or less powerful person.
 
 
• **Example:** He was magnanimous in victory, thanking his opponents for their efforts.
